zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code, h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("a1") as "a1", SUM("a2") as "a2", SUM("b") as "b", SUM("c") as "c", SUM("d") as "d", SUM("e") as "e" , SUM("f") as "f" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE ( h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} ) GROUP BY h.zone_code, h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

hospital.label: โรงพยาบาล
hospital.query: SELECT h.hoscode as a_code, concat(h.hoscode, ':', h.hosname) as a_name, SUM("a1") as "a1", SUM("a2") as "a2", SUM("b") as "b", SUM("c") as "c", SUM("d") as "d", SUM("e") as "e", SUM("f") as "f" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE h.hostype IN ('05', '06', '07', '11', '12', '15') AND h.hdc_regist = 1 AND ( h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} ) GROUP BY h.hoscode, h.hosname ORDER BY h.hoscode
